drhp.business: ASM Technologies integrates product engineering, electronics, embedded systems, software and manufacturing capabilities to help customers move from concept design to scalable manufacturing and lifecycle support. It serves high-growth, advanced industries including Semiconductor, Electronics, Solar, Engineering, Aerospace and Medical through offerings spanning concept design, product engineering, system integration, prototyping, validation and manufacturing, delivered through offshore development/support centers in India and overseas and a global manufacturing network of seven facilities.
drhp.expansion: During FY26, ASM Technologies expanded its manufacturing footprint by commissioning three new facilities — two in Bengaluru and one in Vietnam — taking the total to seven manufacturing facilities in operation as an integrated global manufacturing network. The Company is progressing long-term infrastructure expansion through the proposed development of a new integrated manufacturing facility in Karnataka, supported by land allotted through KIADB (approximately 10 acres). risks.note: Industries are highly competitive and shifting from traditional engineering models towards AI, Industrial AI, automation and intelligent manufacturing, requiring continuous investment in capabilities and offerings to sustain competitiveness.
risks.risk: Competition risk from rapid technological shift

risks.note: A portion of the Company's revenues is generated from international markets, so foreign exchange volatility may impact financial performance; the Company relies on receivable management, cost discipline and FX hedging policies to mitigate this.
Talent availability and retention of skilled professionals remain important given the evolving technology landscape and increasing demand for specialised skills.

Rapid advancements in AI, Industrial AI, automation and intelligent manufacturing are continuously transforming traditional business models, requiring continued investment in technology and innovation to avoid obsolescence.

The Company operates in a global business environment exposed to geopolitical developments, trade restrictions, changing regulatory environments and economic slowdowns across geographies, which may affect customer spending patterns, supply chains and business sentiment; mitigated partly through diversified geographic presence and offshore delivery/manufacturing model.

Increasing adoption of digital technologies, automation and AI-driven solutions across operations requires strong governance frameworks to address data security, system reliability and ethical-use concerns.
The Company is exposed to supply chain disruptions amid a dynamic business environment and evolving regulatory requirements, alongside rising competitive intensity.
